cd /workspace/tmp && timeout 175 python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as impl, fuzz5, fuzz
dead_cases = 0; live_cases = 0; max_dead_frac = 0
for seed in range(1300, 1600):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    req = fuzz5.gen(rng)
    parsed = impl.parse_request(json.loads(json.dumps(req)))
    try:
        order, trans, const_truth, kept, truth, nrep, col_of = impl.build_product(parsed['atoms'], len(parsed['services']))
    except impl.ComplexityError:
        continue
    n = len(order)
    # recompute acceptance/distance like compile_bundle does
    language = impl.evaluate_language(parsed['rules'], const_truth, kept, len(kept))
    nkeep = len(kept)
    acc = bytearray(n)
    if language:
        by_mask = [(language >> mask) & 1 for mask in range(1 << nkeep)]
        for pid in range(n):
            cur = order[pid]; mask = 0
            for j in range(nkeep):
                if cur[j] == truth[j]: mask |= 1 << j
            acc[pid] = by_mask[mask]
    if not any(acc): continue
    preds = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for pid in range(n):
        for t in trans[pid]: preds[t].append(pid)
    dist = [None]*n
    q = [pid for pid in range(n) if acc[pid]]
    for pid in q: dist[pid] = 0
    h = 0
    while h < len(q):
        s = q[h]; h += 1
        for p in preds[s]:
            if dist[p] is None: dist[p] = dist[s]+1; q.append(p)
    ndead = sum(1 for d in dist if d is None)
    if ndead:
        dead_cases += 1
        max_dead_frac = max(max_dead_frac, ndead/n)
    else:
        live_cases += 1
print('cases with dead states: %d, without: %d, max dead fraction %.2f' % (dead_cases, live_cases, max_dead_frac))
EOF
